answer: A public forge of graded work stops fake identities: every answer is hashed into a visible chain tied to one address, so a newcomer starts at zero and must earn trust one graded answer at a time. Reaching the zenith of standing takes weeks of consistent peer-approved work, while a fake costs nothing to create yet cannot borrow another identity's history. Like a plume of smoke marking a single chimney, each chain traces to its source, so flooding the network with fresh fakes only flags them as unproven and keeps their grades worthless.
